unit_pptx_name: Term 4 Week 6 - Maths Test Revision - Year 5-6 Maths.pptx
anchor: Read it. Work it. Check it.

lessons.focus: 30 minutes. Twins of the 14 number and algebra test questions (Grade 5 Q1-3, 7-12; Grade 6 Q3, 7, 10-12). Critical feature: read what the question really asks before calculating. No Daily Review or Fluency (teacher's request).

60 minutes. Twins of the 40 fraction, percentage, measurement, space, data and chance test questions (Grade 5 Q4-6, 13-29; Grade 6 Q1-2, 4-6, 8-9, 13-25). Critical feature: find what one step, piece or part is worth. No Daily Review or Fluency (teacher's request).
